description: This Zenodo benchmark extends sixty Homberger vehicle-routing instances, each with one thousand customers, to include heterogeneous EV charging stations. The LPRI and ENSET Mohammedia team supplies two time-window variants, yielding 120 problems, with station attributes, vehicle settings, random seeds and generation scripts. Text instances, CSV station tables and JSON parameters are bundled in a freely accessible ZIP under CC BY 4.0. The global, geographically abstract cases can benchmark routing and charging optimisation simulations under different waiting-time, price and charging-rate assumptions. Coverage is limited to synthetic station positions and attributes, and one variant deliberately relaxes customer deadlines. Original Homberger instances are included unchanged, so their provenance remains distinct. No directly related catalogue benchmark was identified.
